suite.notes: Every second repetition reverses case order. Diagnostic atomic/readback overhead is included only in explicitly labelled diagnostic runs. Compare matching route modes and sample counts. Diagnostic snapshots sample every 15th frame; cache counters sample 1/64 pixels of the latest completed render, not the whole route.

build_manifest.variantPolicy: Extension-only: compact ON, height/palette/shape/spatial/traversal OFF; density equals lighting; normal and far surface are independent alternatives. Allowed presets: baseline, reference-performance, performance, normal-cache, surface-hybrid.
build_manifest.notes: FHD window, VSync disabled by runtime harness, FrameTiming enabled. Build does not auto-connect a Profiler. Dedicated CLI benchmark binary; use -cloudBenchmark with the allowed presets and -cloudQuit. Startup uses performance settings; other runtime panel combinations are not supported.

notes: Independent extension-only Development build. Historical Development/Release measurements are not pooled.
Missing GPU data is N/A/null, never zero. GPU and FrameTiming streams are delayed, not aligned one-to-one with poses.
Cloud.Total contains child scopes. Do not add optional build times to total.
Timing does not establish image/geometry acceptance. Read independent normal/far validation reports.
Two repeats show observed variation, not broad reproducibility.
